identityReviewRetry.reason: Faiima's staged central face repeats Safuna's open almond eyes, fine nose and softly bowed lips instead of native Faiima's compact nasal end and more elongated lifted eyes.
identityReviewRetry.observedSource: Native Faiima has youthful soft cheeks, a tapering small chin, amber-gold dark-rimmed eyes with strong lifted outer corners, a compact short nose and swept-back chestnut hair.
identityReviewRetry.observedResult: The frozen portrait has a longer finer nose and broad open almond eyes close to Safuna; hair and jewelry cannot separate them.
